current_prompt.body:
READ each statement from the supplied privacy policy excerpt
FOR EACH statement DO
MAP the statement to the specific GDPR article(s) it relates to
ENDFOR
IDENTIFY any GDPR requirements that are not addressed by any statement in the policy excerpt
RETURN a list pairing each policy statement with its corresponding GDPR article(s) and a separate list of uncovered GDPR requirements
